N-4.1-A.skill: eliminate the parameter from a trigonometric parametrization and identify exactly which part of the curve a restricted interval traces, with direction.

N-4.2-A.skill: decide when a moving particle is at a given point by requiring both coordinate equations to hold at the same time, including a point the path passes through twice.

N-4.3-A.skill: separate the average rates of change of x(t) and y(t) with respect to t from the average rate of change of y with respect to x, and compute the latter as a ratio of net changes.

N-4.4-A.skill: read the center, radius, direction and period of circular motion directly from parametric equations.

N-4.5-A.skill: test points against an implicit relation and use them to decide whether y is a function of x, without swapping coordinates or being misled by symmetry.

N-4.6-A.skill: complete the square on a general second-degree equation to identify the conic and read off its center and the endpoints of its axis, vertices or focus.

N-4.7-A.skill: choose a parametrization that traces an entire implicitly defined curve, checking the denominators, shifts and parameter interval.
